Citrus Rosemary Popcorn

Served at: Polaris Meteor Watch & UFO Evening

Serves 4-6Prep 10 minCook 10 min

This vibrant Citrus Rosemary Popcorn is the perfect celestial snack for your Polaris Meteor Watch & UFO Evening. Its bright, aromatic flavors of fresh citrus and earthy rosemary offer a comforting warmth under the night sky, making it an ideal companion for stargazing and speculative conversations.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 cup (100 g) unpopped popcorn kernels
  • 2 tablespoons (30 ml) coconut oil or vegetable oil
  • 4 tablespoons (56 g) unsalted butter
  • 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, leaves finely chopped (about 1 tablespoon)
  • Zest of 1 large lemon (or 1/2 orange)
  • 1 teaspoon (5 g) fine sea salt, or to taste

Method

  1. Heat the coconut or vegetable oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot with a lid over medium-high heat.
  2. Add 3-4 popcorn kernels to the pot, cover, and wait for them to pop. This indicates the oil is hot enough.
  3. Remove the test kernels, add the remaining 1/2 cup (100 g) popcorn kernels in an even layer, and cover the pot.
  4. Once popping begins, gently shake the pot occasionally to prevent burning. Continue cooking until the popping slows to several seconds between pops, then remove from heat.
  5. Immediately transfer the popped popcorn to a very large bowl.
  6. In a small saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over medium-low heat. Add the finely chopped fresh rosemary and let it simmer gently for 2-3 minutes, allowing the rosemary to infuse its flavor into the butter.
  7. Remove the butter from the heat and stir in the lemon zest and fine sea salt.
  8. Pour the warm rosemary-citrus butter mixture evenly over the popped popcorn in the large bowl.
  9. Toss thoroughly with a large spoon or spatula until all the popcorn is lightly coated. Taste and add more salt if desired.
  10. Serve immediately for the best flavor and texture during your celestial event.

Tips

  • For an extra kick, add a pinch of red pepper flakes to the butter mixture.
  • Try orange zest for a sweeter, more mellow citrus note.
  • Ensure your popcorn is completely dry before adding the butter to prevent sogginess.
